title: Firetrucks, Fireboats, and Future Heroes: Inside the LAFD
description:
Los Angeles fire stations recently opened their doors to celebrate community connection and inspire the next generation of local heroes.

For Fire Service Day, 104 LAFD stations welcomed the public for an exclusive look at daily operations. Families met local firefighters, explored massive rescue trucks, and learned vital safety skills. The interactive event also featured key neighborhood safety groups, including the LA Port Police and the Community Emergency Response Team.

Beyond the hands-on fun, outreach officers connected with youth and young adults interested in public service careers. They hope to find new recruits who share a deep passion for helping others and serving their city.
